articles.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026: Everything you need to know
articles.description: TechCrunch Founder Summit is a full-day gathering in Boston on November 4 where founders across all stages connect with top VCs and experienced entrepreneurs to gain tactical insights on building and scaling their companies.

articles.title: Meta says Muse has over 10M users, with shopping a top activity
articles.description: Meta Muse users are adopting the app for shopping and personal productivity, the company said during Q3 earnings. The AI app now has over 10M users.

articles.title: Year-old AI lab Flapping Airplanes raises $1B at a $6B valuation
articles.description: Just 9 months after raising an $180 million seed round, Flapping Airplanes has landed $1 billion Series A for its mission to build AI models "without ingesting half the internet."

articles.title: Tesla starts Optimus robot production in California as profit falls 43%
articles.description: Tesla's revenue was flat and its expenses skyrocketed as it pressed the accelerator on its Optimus robots, AI, and autonomous driving.

articles.title: Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model it says was largely built by AI
articles.description: Startup Recursive has released Flint, a free, laptop-sized coding model built largely by its own AI research system, as an early test of AI that improves itself.

articles.title: Tether backs Bolivian fintech bringing USDT payments to food delivery and banking
articles.description: The investment will support Peso’s expansion across four Latin American markets, where it connects stablecoin payments to merchant services and local banking networks.

articles.title: Trump didn‘t mention ‘crypto’ once in White House cybercrime roundtable
articles.description: The US President detailed many schemes defrauding Americans, but referred only to “cybercurrency“ related to scams.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: GM is betting compute and AI will help it compete with Chinese automakers
articles.description: To compete with Tesla, Rivian, and a host of Chinese automakers, GM’s fourth-gen EV platform will roll out a new central computer and electrical architecture that will debut in 2028 in the Cadillac Escalade IQ.

articles.title: Meta ordered to pay $25 billion in case related to Cambridge Analytica scandal
articles.description: The payout is related to a recent trial involving the social media giant that revolved around its data privacy practices.

articles.title: While Amazon blocks AI agents, Walmart rolls out the welcome mat
articles.description: As Amazon blocks AI agents from shopping on its site, Walmart is taking the opposite approach, introducing new technology that lets AI agents make purchases on customers' behalf, with controls over spending and transaction approvals.

articles.title: The internet is having a very bad cybersecurity day
articles.description: From AI-discovered PHP vulnerabilities to flaws in Node.js and popular AI tool LiteLLM, cybersecurity teams have plenty to worry about this week.

articles.title: Legal AI startup Legora raises $550M Series E at $8.8B valuation
articles.description: Legal AI startup Legora announced Wednesday that it raised a $550 million Series E round, valuing it at $8.8 billion.

articles.title: GM is giving OnStar an AI makeover
articles.description: It's one of the biggest overhauls ever to the 30-year-old connected car product.

articles.title: PHP armageddon: OpenAI, Google’s Wiz find ancient holes, panicking the internet
articles.description: This is the kind of security issue that was found and prevented by AI, but is also a high risk because of AI.

articles.title: Cardano Foundation urges EU against expanding MiCA rules to DeFi and staking
articles.description: The foundation called for regulation based on financial risks rather than technology, warning that overlapping rules could create uncertainty for crypto businesses across the EU.

articles.title: UK financial watchdog opens consultations for DeFi guidance, crypto laws
articles.description: The UK Financial Conduct Authority consultations came just weeks after the agency opened applications for companies under its new crypto regulatory regime.

articles.title: Blacksmith hits unicorn valuation after Sequoia leads Series C
articles.description: Blacksmith, a platform that lets companies build and test AI code more effectively, just announced a $66 million Series C round led by Sequoia that values the company at $1 billion.

articles.title: Treasury Secretary Bessent likens GENIUS Act to Lincoln-era banking reform
articles.description: The OCC has finalized rules for stablecoin reserves and redemptions, with Bessent calling the GENIUS Act a “watershed moment for American finance.”

articles.title: Waymo starts offering rides at the Las Vegas airport
articles.description: Pickups and dropoffs will happen at dedicated "autonomous vehicle zones" at Terminal 1 and Terminal 3.
